title: Almaty Winter Group Tour with Flights
alt: Skiers on the slopes of the Shymbulak resort above Almaty
transport: Return flights from Delhi, group transfers and shared day tours

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Warm city hotel with a sauna and indoor pool

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A shared day up to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu and on by gondola to Shymbulak, with the lift ticket included.

activities.name: Green Bazaar, Rakhat factory and Abay Street walk
activities.match: Walking Tour of Green Bazar, Rakhat Chocolate Factory & Abay
activities.description: A walking tour of the Green Bazaar halls and the Rakhat chocolate shop, finishing along the cafes of Abay Street.

activities.name: Almaty sightseeing tour
activities.description: A shared tour taking in the Central Market, Arbat street, the President Park and the Monument of Independence.

activities.name: Kok Tobe hill and the gondola
activities.match: Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty
activities.description: The cable car up Kok Tobe for the whole city laid out below the mountains, with the Alley of Lovers at the top.

activities.name: Almarasan National Park
activities.match: Day Trip to Almarsan National Park
activities.description: A shared day in the Alma Arasan gorge, a forested valley of spruce and hot springs on the edge of the Ile Alatau range.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Four nights in the old capital on a shared group basis, with Shymbulak, the Green Bazaar, Kok Tobe and the Almarasan gorge.

1: Flight Delhi to Almaty included in the price
Arrival at Almaty International and transfer to your hotel
The day at leisure once you have checked in
Optional: the Palace of the Republic and Abai Square
2: Breakfast, then up the Malaya Almatinka valley
The Medeu dam and its Olympic skating rink
On by gondola to Shymbulak with the lift ticket
A walk round the Green Bazaar and Abay Street
3: Breakfast, then a shared tour of the city
The Central Market and Arbat street
The President Park and the Monument of Independence
Up the Kok Tobe cable car for the city at dusk
4: Breakfast, then southwest into the Alma Arasan gorge
Spruce forest and hot springs in Almarasan park
The Ile Alatau ridges rising behind the valley
Evening transfer back into the city
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Airport transfer and your flight Almaty to Delhi

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: A shared group tour with the Delhi flights in it. For snow in January this is the cheapest way out of India that still feels like abroad.
expert.tip: Hire boots and a jacket at Shymbulak rather than packing your own. Almaty rates are a fraction of what the Alps charge.

summary: Five days in Almaty on a shared group basis with return flights from Delhi: the Medeu rink and Shymbulak gondola with lift ticket, a Green Bazaar and chocolate factory walk, a city tour with Kok Tobe, and a day in the Almarasan gorge.
included: Included: return flights Delhi to Almaty; 4 nights in Almaty with daily breakfast; group airport transfers; shared Medeu and Shymbulak day trip with lift ticket; Green Bazaar, Rakhat chocolate factory and Abay Street walking tour; shared Almaty sightseeing tour; shared Kok Tobe day trip; shared Almarasan National Park day trip; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: Kazakhstan visa fees; meals beyond breakfast; tips for the driver, guide and hotel staff; personal expenses.
